batch.topic: A data table uses an empty cell for an unrecorded measurement and the value0 for an observed zero; preserve the distinction in an export.
A code example describes an optional argument whose default applies only when the argument is omitted, not when an explicit null is supplied.
A report separates a measured temperature from the temperature used to calibrate a sensor; later calibration does not change the earlier recorded value.
A graph plots cumulative counts, so a horizontal segment means no new observations during that interval, not that the total count is zero.
